ground_truth.title: State v. Daniel Ruiz
ground_truth.location: Townsville, Construction Site of the Skyline Tower

defendant.name: Daniel Ruiz
defendant.background: Former competitive bodybuilder, recently began training at Skyline Tower gym.

victim.name: Skyline Tower Development Company
victim.description: Owner of the construction site and supplier of high‑value jewelry used in décor.

ground_truth.what_really_happened: During a night shift at the Skyline Tower construction site, the security guard noticed a breach in the storage room where jewelry used for interior design was kept. Daniel Ruiz, who had been training at the tower’s gym, slipped into the storage area, concealed a case of sapphire jewelry in his gym bag, and left the site while the guard was distracted by a phone call. The guard later discovered the empty case. An alarm was triggered, but the burglar had already escaped before it went off.

timeline.event: Guard receives phone call and leaves workstation
Daniel Ruiz enters storage room, removes jewelry
Daniel Ruiz exits site with jewelry
Guard notices missing jewelry, triggers alarm
Security patrol reports missing jewelry to police

evidence.name: Security Footage
evidence.description: Video captured a lone individual in gym clothes entering the storage room at 21:20. The footage shows a figure that matches Daniel Ruiz’s height and build.
evidence.truth_note: The footage records the actual intruder, who is Daniel Ruiz.

evidence.name: Gym Bag Swab
evidence.description: A swab taken from the inner lining of Daniel Ruiz’s gym bag tested positive for traces of glass fragments from the jewelry case.
evidence.truth_note: The glass fragments are from the broken case that Daniel Ruiz removed.

evidence.name: Fingerprint on Door Handle
evidence.description: A single partial fingerprint was found on the storage room door handle, matching Daniel Ruiz’s fingerprint profile.
evidence.truth_note: The fingerprint belongs to the actual intruder, Daniel Ruiz.

evidence.name: Guard’s Phone Call Log
evidence.description: The guard’s phone call log shows a 5‑minute call at 21:15 during which the guard’s audio recording is inaudible.
evidence.truth_note: The call is a legitimate communication that created an opportunity for the theft, but it does not implicate any other party.

evidence.name: Construction Site Layout Plan
evidence.description: The layout plan indicates that the storage room is accessible only through the gym entrance, which Daniel Ruiz regularly used.
evidence.truth_note: The plan shows a legitimate access route, but does not prove who used it.

evidence.name: Anonymous Tip
evidence.description: An anonymous tipline received a message claiming Daniel Ruiz was seen near the storage room on the night of the theft.
evidence.truth_note: The tip may refer to a misidentification or someone else sharing Daniel’s features; the tip is unverified.

witnesses.name: Lisa Patel
witnesses.knows: Observed the guard’s phone call and later discovered missing jewelry
witnesses.bias: Protects the company’s reputation; believes someone inside the company did it

witnesses.name: Tom Bennett
witnesses.role: Gym Instructor at Skyline Tower Gym
witnesses.knows: Saw Daniel Ruiz carrying a gym bag late at night
witnesses.bias: Friend of Daniel, wants to help him avoid blame
